_comment: THE LOOP SWAPS ITS OWN OUTLET when colourless is the binding resource.
USER, writing rule 4 of the Combo Off table: 'the 1 colourless source works even when you
have displacer out because you can draw into Emiel and cast it if you can draw your deck.'
The rule table believed that; the executor never did it.
Eldrazi Displacer's blink is {2}{C} and Emiel the Blessed's is {3} -- same mana value, and
one of them spends a colourless PIP every pass. Cloud of Faeries untaps two lands and the
{C}-starved reservation makes exactly one of them colourless, so the Displacer loop nets ZERO
colourless and Essence Depleter's {1}{C} is fed only by the board's opening supply.
MEASURED on this exact board: without the swap, 14 blinks and NINE drains of the twenty the
kill needs; with it, 20 blinks and 20 drains, opponent dead. Both halves are required --
MTG_COMBO_OFF_OUTLET_SWITCH deploys the held Emiel and switches mid-loop, and the recognizer
then sizes the count on the POST-SWAP colourless net (PipFreeOutletFromHandLive), without
which the swap works perfectly and the loop still stops three drains short at 17.
Across the sweep, `loop.net_c <= 0` produced 42 offers and ZERO wins while `net_c > 0` won
81.4% -- the pip is the whole difference (docs/design/combo-off-sweep-catalogue.md, C3).
